details:
version 2019.4.31.12409535(This is the version that was written in the vrchat client, but perhaps it is the Unity version and not the Vrchat version, but I can't find a way to check the version of Vrchat itself when I look into it.)
Specification environment: Oculus Quest2, wired connection; Haritora X
(1)
When I use Hip lock in IK 2.0, the position of the avatar is shifted only while it is moving. This happens not only with one avatar, but with multiple avatars.
I was told by a friend that the position is shifted by one fist only while moving. It seems that it is not only the view point that is out of alignment.
There is one on Reddit with similar symptoms to mine.
"https://www.reddit.com/r/VRchat/comments/w5lso3/everytime_i_move_using_lock_hip_tracking_my_whole/"
In the Reddit one it occurs in a sitting position, but in my case it occurs even when I'm standing upright. 
It seems that the closer the viewpoint is level with the ground, the less the displacement, and the more it faces toward the ground, the greater the displacement.
This is very uncomfortable because every time I move and stop, my hand shifts position significantly.
2) When I enable elbow tracking in IK 2.0, the shoulder bones seem to shift forward and pop out of place. Also, turning off shoulder tracking solves the shoulder bone issue, but the elbow always points outward regardless of whether shoulder tracking is on or off. Even with the arms close to the waist and the elbows bent directly back, the avatar's figure will look as if the elbows are bent directly to the side with the elbows pointing outward. This does not seem to be a problem with the tracker itself, as the estimated posture in the tracker app is closer to the actual posture.
title: IK2.0 is behaving strangely. Avatar's position shifts a lot when moving. Elbow tracking is wrong.
